day-close-tender.name: Day Close Tender
day-close-tender.description: From their close report or drawer sheet, list tender types and amounts they recorded for one clinic date. Do not store PAN or check account numbers.

day-list.name: Day List
day-list.description: From the schedule export, list the day by time, provider, type, and their patient label.

eligibility-from-screenshot.name: Eligibility From Screenshot
eligibility-from-screenshot.description: Quote only the dated screenshot or clearinghouse print they saved. Do not invent remaining benefits.

intake-completeness.name: Intake Completeness
intake-completeness.description: From PDFs they share, list missing pages and signatures as questions. No clinical reading of history answers.

no-show-list.name: No Show List
no-show-list.description: From the day-list or EHR export, list rows they already coded no-show, late cancel, or broken.

recall-list-if-file.name: Recall List If File
recall-list-if-file.description: If they exported a recall or reminder list, shape it. Do not message patients or invent a due date.

records-release-log.name: Records Release Log
records-release-log.description: From the ROI folder and their release log, list request date, requester type, ROI present or missing, and send status.

referral-paperwork.name: Referral Paperwork
referral-paperwork.description: From the referral PDF folder, list inbound and outbound packets as complete or missing named pages.

wait-list.name: Wait List
wait-list.description: From their wait-list file, keep their order and requested type and provider. They choose who is offered.

preseeded_role: Medical clinic front role (not the clinician)
